Electronic Stability Control and four-wheel disc ABS brakes round out the comprehensive safety suite.

The cabin comforts reflect the Limited trim's focus on quality. Heated front seats wrapped in perforated leather offer warmth during cooler months, while the power moonroof floods the interior with natural light. The Harman Kardon audio system delivers superior sound quality, and the 7.0-inch touchscreen navigation system with voice control keeps you connected and informed. Bluetooth hands-free connectivity, smartphone integration, and dual USB ports ensure seamless device integration for modern driving.

Practical amenities make daily ownership straightforward. The power liftgate simplifies cargo loading, the power driver seat adjusts for optimal positioning, and the telescoping steering wheel accommodates various driving preferences. Climate control maintains temperature comfort, while the rear window defroster and heated door mirrors enhance visibility during inclement weather.

This 2021 Nissan Sentra S in White represents an excellent opportunity for buyers seeking reliable, efficient transportation. As a one-owner vehicle with 68,243 miles, this sedan has been well-maintained and delivers consistent value. The 2.0L DOHC engine paired with CVT Xtronic transmission provides smooth power delivery with strong fuel economy ratings of 29 MPG city and 39 MPG highway, making it practical for both daily commuting and longer drives.

The Sentra S is equipped with comprehensive safety features designed to protect you and your passengers. Blind spot warning and rear parking sensors help you navigate with confidence, while electronic stability control, traction control, and a full suite of airbags provide protection in unexpected situations. ABS brakes and brake assist technology work together to enhance stopping capability when you need it most.

Modern connectivity is built into this vehicle through NissanConnect, which seamlessly integrates Apple CarPlay and Android Auto functionality into the AM/FM radio system with RDS/MP3 and auxiliary input. Steering wheel mounted audio controls allow you to manage entertainment and communications without taking your hands off the wheel, enhancing both convenience and safety during your drive.

Inside, you'll find a practical and comfortable cabin with cloth seat trim, front bucket seats, and a front center armrest. The split folding rear seat provides flexibility for cargo management, while the split and tilt steering wheel accommodates drivers of various heights. Additional conveniences include power windows, power mirrors, remote keyless entry, and climate control through the air conditioning system with rear window defroster functionality.

This Sentra has been well-equipped for protection and durability. The clear rear bumper protector, body-colored splash guards, and body-colored bumpers help preserve the vehicle's finish and protect critical areas from road hazard damage. The 16-inch steel wheels with full wheel covers provide dependable wheel support while maintaining a clean appearance.

Discover a compact SUV with standout two-tone styling, all-wheel-drive confidence and everyday versatility. This 2020 Hyundai Kona SEL pairs Sonic Silver paint with a contrasting Black roof and a Gray/Black interior. The SEL trim adds comfort and technology that make every drive more enjoyable.

PERFORMANCE & CAPABILITY

Under the hood is a 2.0L four-cylinder engine paired with a 6-speed automatic transmission. Automatic full-time all-wheel drive helps deliver traction when roads turn wet or snowy, while traction control, electronic stability control and a brake-actuated limited-slip differential help manage challenging conditions. Four-wheel disc brakes with ABS and brake assist add stopping confidence. A driver-selectable transmission mode lets you tailor the driving experience. With responsive steering and compact dimensions, this Kona is equally at home on city streets, suburban roads and highway trips.

FEATURES & OPTIONS

The Sonic Silver exterior and Black roof create an eye-catching contrast, complemented by alloy wheels, a black grille, rear spoiler, privacy glass, body-colored door handles and black wheel-well cladding. Automatic headlights, daytime running lights, heated power mirrors with integrated turn signals, rear defrost and variable-speed intermittent wipers add useful convenience.

Inside, heated front bucket seats help take the chill out of Pennsylvania mornings. Cloth upholstery, a leather-wrapped steering wheel, adjustable steering column, power windows, power door locks, keyless entry and push-button start provide a comfortable, easy-to-use cabin. Cruise control makes longer drives more relaxed. The rear bench seat includes a pass-through design, while the cargo shade, concealed cargo storage, cargo lighting and reversible cargo tray help organize groceries, luggage and daily gear. Floor mats and a first aid kit are also included.

Stay connected with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto smartphone integration, Bluetooth connectivity, AM/FM radio, HD Radio, satellite radio capability, an auxiliary audio input and a six-speaker sound system. Steering-wheel audio controls keep frequently used functions close at hand, and the trip computer displays useful driving information. A backup camera makes reversing and parking easier.

SAFETY & SECURITY

The Kona SEL includes a range of driver-assistance and safety equipment: forward collision-avoidance assist, lane keeping assist, lane departure warning, blind-spot monitoring, rear cross-traffic alert and driver attention monitoring. Front, side and curtain airbags, child safety locks, an immobilizer, a security system and a tire-pressure monitoring system provide additional layers of protection. These systems assist the driver and do not replace attentive driving.

WHY BUY THIS KONA?

This 2020 Kona SEL combines AWD capability, heated front seats, smartphone connectivity and practical cargo space in a distinctive compact SUV. Its two-tone Sonic Silver and Black roof design stands apart from ordinary crossovers, while its convenient size makes parking and navigating crowded areas simple. Whether you're shopping for a first SUV, a commuter vehicle or an everyday all-weather crossover, this Kona delivers a compelling mix of utility, comfort and technology. Available through Bowser Hyundai for shoppers across Pittsburgh, Beaver Falls, Chippewa, Cranberry Township, Wexford and the surrounding Western Pennsylvania region.

The 2014 Jeep Wrangler Sport 4x4 is a popular choice for Colorado drivers who want a vehicle built for adventure. With its iconic Jeep styling, body-on-frame construction, four-wheel-drive capability, removable top and doors, and impressive off-road heritage, the Wrangler Sport is well suited to Colorado's mountains, trails, camping destinations, and changing weather conditions.

One of the biggest advantages of the Wrangler Sport is its 4x4 drivetrain. Colorado drivers can benefit from additional traction when traveling through snow, mud, loose gravel, and other challenging surfaces.

The Jeep Wrangler has a long-standing reputation for off-road performance. Its rugged chassis, solid axles, available low-range gearing, and high ground clearance give the Wrangler the hardware needed for demanding trails.

Colorado is an excellent environment for an adventure-oriented vehicle. The Wrangler Sport can be a great companion for hiking trips, camping weekends, fishing excursions, skiing adventures, and scenic mountain drives.

Few SUVs provide the open-air experience of a Jeep Wrangler. Depending on its configuration, the 2014 Wrangler can allow drivers to remove the top and doors, creating an especially enjoyable way to experience Colorado's scenery.

On a sunny summer day, an open-air drive through the mountains can turn an ordinary trip into an adventure.

Colorado's unpaved roads can include rocks, ruts, uneven surfaces, and other obstacles. The Wrangler's elevated ride height and off-road-oriented design provide useful clearance when navigating these conditions.

Although the Wrangler is capable off-road, it isn't as large as many full-size SUVs and trucks. Its relatively compact dimensions can be advantageous on narrow trails and forest roads.

The Wrangler's traditional body-on-frame design and durable suspension components contribute to its reputation as a rugged off-road vehicle.

The Wrangler Sport can also provide useful utility for Colorado recreation. Depending on configuration and equipment, it can tow a small trailer or carry outdoor equipment for activities such as camping and recreational travel.

The Wrangler's unmistakable seven-slot grille, round headlights, upright windshield, removable top, and rugged exterior give it an instantly recognizable appearance.

Colorado winters can produce snow and icy conditions, particularly at higher elevations. The Wrangler's available four-wheel-drive system provides an important advantage when additional traction is needed.

The 2014 Jeep Wrangler Sport 4x4 is particularly well suited to drivers who spend their free time outdoors. Whether you're heading toward a trailhead, campsite, fishing location, or mountain destination, the Wrangler's rugged design provides the versatility to go farther off the beaten path.

Its open-air capability also makes it especially enjoyable during Colorado's warmer months, when drivers can take advantage of the state's scenic roads and spectacular mountain views.

Safety is integrated throughout this sedan with multiple airbag coverage, stability systems, and warning features designed to help protect occupants. The electronic stability control and four-wheel independent suspension work together to provide confident handling across different road conditions. Rear parking sensors and blind spot warnings add practical assistance during maneuvering.

The 2.0-liter four-cylinder engine paired with Xtronic transmission balances efficiency with responsive performance. With 30 city and 40 highway miles per gallon, this sedan helps manage fuel costs without sacrificing everyday usability. The compact front-wheel-drive design maximizes interior space while maintaining agility on city streets and highways alike.

The vehicle presents an excellent opportunity for buyers who prioritize reliability, efficiency, and practical features in a straightforward sedan package. This Sentra SV offers the connectivity and safety standards expected in today's vehicles without unnecessary complexity.

Anybody who has driven kids to Seattle knows the exact minute it goes sideways. Somewhere past Ellensburg the tablet dies and the negotiating starts. Over your head a power moonroof, out back a power liftgate, and running boards down the sides so shorter passengers can climb in without a boost. Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, seven speakers with SiriusXM, steering wheel audio controls, HomeLink, an auto dimming rear view mirror with compass, and a rear parking camera.

Three row all wheel drive with the entertainment system and leather, at a price that reflects the miles rather than the equipment. That is a real value if you are hauling a family and not trying to make a payment hurt. Come drive it. Archibald's, , 6902 W Clearwater Ave in Kennewick.

This 2025 Chevrolet TrailBlazer LT in striking red combines practical design with reliable performance for everyday driving and weekend adventures.

- 1.3L Turbocharged engine with 155 horsepower and 9-speed automatic transmission
- All-Wheel Drive for confident handling in varying conditions
- Wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration
- SiriusXM satellite radio with trial subscription
- 6-speaker audio system with amplifier
- Rear exterior parking camera
- Heated power door mirrors
- Remote keyless entry with panic alarm
- Fully automatic headlights with delay-off feature
- Split folding rear seat for flexible cargo space
- 17-inch high gloss black machined aluminum wheels
- Electronic stability and traction control
- OnStar connected services capability
- Front and rear USB ports (Type-A and Type-C)
- Dual front and side impact airbags with knee and overhead airbags

The TrailBlazer LT delivers impressive fuel efficiency with an EPA-estimated 26 city and 29 highway MPG, helping you travel farther between fill-ups. The turbocharged engine provides responsive acceleration while maintaining efficiency, and the nine-speed automatic transmission adapts smoothly to your driving needs. All-wheel drive enhances traction and stability, whether you're navigating city streets or handling seasonal weather.

Inside, you'll find a comfortable cabin designed with your convenience in mind. The front bucket seats with a center armrest provide support for daily commutes, while the split folding rear seat adapts to accommodate passengers or cargo as needed. The integrated 6-speaker audio system pairs seamlessly with wireless smartphone connectivity, keeping you entertained throughout your journey. Climate control with air conditioning and a rear window defroster ensures comfort year-round.

Safety is built into every aspect of this vehicle. The comprehensive airbag system includes front dual impact, front side impact, knee, and overhead protection. Electronic stability control and traction control work together to maintain vehicle dynamics, while the four-wheel disc brake system with ABS provides responsive stopping power. The rear parking camera helps you maneuver with confidence.

Practical features enhance daily usability and convenience. Power windows and door locks, tilt and telescoping steering wheel adjustment, and illuminated entry make everyday tasks effortless. The trip computer and compass provide useful driving data, while the remote keyless entry with security system offers peace of mind.

description:
Step into a 2017 Volvo XC90 T6 AWD Momentum finished in Ice White, a seven-passenger luxury SUV that feels as composed on a mountain pass as it does at the school pickup line. Under the sculpted hood, a 2.0-liter supercharged and turbocharged direct-injection engine delivers 316 horsepower and 295 lb-ft of torque through an 8-speed Geartronic automatic with start-stop, sending power to all four wheels with Instant Traction all-wheel drive. Double-wishbone front and integral-axle rear suspension, adjustable drive modes, electric power-assisted steering, ABS with Hill Start Assist, and advanced Electronic Stability Control give it a planted, confident character that never feels hurried to announce itself.

Open the doors and the cabin unfolds as a Scandinavian lounge on wheels. A laminated panoramic moonroof with power sunshade floods the interior with light, while leather seating surfaces, heated 10-way power front seats with driver memory, and a leather-wrapped tilt-and-telescopic steering wheel wrap every occupant in quiet comfort. Three rows welcome seven with 40/20/40 flat-folding seats that vanish into a cargo floor when adventure calls. Four-zone electronic climate control and Volvo s Clean Zone air-quality system keep the air as refined as the ride, and tinted rear and cargo glass, roof rails, dual integrated tailpipes, and a high-gloss black grille complete the presence outside.

The Momentum Plus Package turns night driving into theater. Full LED headlights with Active Bending Lights, Auto Highbeam, and Volvo s signature Thor s Hammer daytime running lamps sweep the road ahead, while high-pressure headlight cleaning keeps the view crisp. Inside, Dark Flame Birch wood inlays, illuminated sill plates, and high-level interior illumination create a warm, tailored glow. Apple CarPlay and a USB hub bring your digital world onto the integrated 9-inch Sensus touchscreen, joined by Sensus Navigation, a 330-watt ten-speaker high-performance audio system, HD Radio, Bluetooth streaming, SiriusXM with complimentary trial service, a Wi-Fi hotspot, and a crisp 12.3-inch digital instrument display. Volvo On-Call keeps the vehicle connected with complimentary roadside support.

The Vision Package adds a 360-degree surround-view camera, retractable and automatically dimming inner and exterior mirrors, Blind Spot Information, and Cross Traffic Alert, so changing lanes and backing out of a crowded lot feel almost effortless. The Convenience Package goes further still, layering Pilot Assist semi-autonomous driving with adaptive cruise control, Park Assist Pilot with front and rear park assist, HomeLink, a grocery-bag holder, cargo-area power, and a compass in the interior mirror. A hands-free power tailgate, keyless entry and drive, rear park-assist camera, and 20-inch eight-double-spoke diamond-cut alloy wheels (paired with the Protection Package Plus and a second-row center booster) make everyday use feel considered rather than compromised.

Safety is not an accessory here; it is the architecture. City Safety low-speed collision avoidance watches for vehicles, pedestrians, cyclists, and large animals. Run-off Road Protection and Mitigation, Lane Departure Warning, Driver Alert Control, Road Sign Information, Roll Stability Control, and a tire-pressure monitoring system work quietly in the background. A high-strength steel safety cage, dual-stage and dual-chamber airbags, inflatable curtains through the third row, Side Impact Protection, Whiplash Protection in the front seats, seven three-point belts with pretensioners, child safety locks, LATCH anchors, and ten-year emergency crash notification earned this XC90 a five-star overall NHTSA score, with five-star frontal and side ratings.

This is the XC90 at its most complete Momentum expression: powerful without shouting, luxurious without fuss, and engineered so the drive home feels like the best part of the day.

description:
This 2013 Chevrolet Camaro 2LT isn't your typical V6 Camaro. It's a Dusk Special Edition finished in Blue Ray Metallic with a Dusk Mojave leather interior, combining distinctive factory styling with the comfort and technology of the 2LT trim. Power comes from Chevrolet's 3.6L SIDI DOHC V6 VVT engine paired with a 6-speed automatic transmission with TAPSHIFT.

The Dusk Special Edition gives this Camaro a look that immediately separates it from the standard car, with 21-inch Bright Silver-Painted Wheels and a rear spoiler complementing the Blue Ray Metallic exterior. This car also carries the RS Package, adding High Intensity Discharge headlamps and body-color roof ditch molding for an even sharper factory appearance.

Inside, the 2LT brings a surprisingly premium side to the Camaro. Leather seating surfaces, heated driver and front passenger seats, front sport bucket seats, a leather-wrapped steering wheel and shift knob, and a Head-Up Display create a cockpit that feels appropriately driver-focused while still offering plenty of comfort. Auxiliary multi-function gauges add another performance-inspired touch to the interior.

Entertainment comes through an AM/FM stereo with color touch display and Boston Acoustics premium 9-speaker audio system. Steering-wheel-mounted audio controls and a USB audio connection add everyday convenience, while Remote Vehicle Start, Remote Keyless Entry, Universal Home Remote, and electronic cruise control round out the feature set.

Underneath the styling, the Camaro retains its performance-oriented foundation with StabiliTrak, 4-wheel antilock disc brakes, stainless-steel dual-outlet exhaust, and TAPSHIFT control for the 6-speed automatic. The result is a coupe that delivers the look and feel buyers expect from a Camaro while offering the more approachable everyday character of the V6 powertrain.

The 2013 Camaro also came from an award-winning run for Chevrolet's modern muscle car. Kelley Blue Book recognized the Camaro among its 2013 Best Resale Value Award winners, adding another accolade to a generation already known for bringing unmistakable Camaro styling back to the road.

With its Dusk Special Edition, Blue Ray Metallic paint, Dusk Mojave leather interior, RS Package, 21-inch wheels, 3.6L V6, TAPSHIFT automatic, heated leather seats, Head-Up Display, Boston Acoustics premium audio, color touchscreen, and Remote Start, this 2013 Chevrolet Camaro 2LT offers something beyond the ordinary V6 Camaroa distinctive special-edition combination of muscle-car styling, premium comfort, technology, and everyday performance.

We price our cars to be competitive so there's no haggling to get a good deal. Valley GMC. Where you're a neighbor, not a number.


When the Trailer Is This Big, the Truck Matters Even More

Pulling a big RV over a mountain pass has a way of making you appreciate having the right truck underneath you.

It's not just about power. You want a truck that feels like it was built for serious work, especially when there's a long grade ahead, changing weather, and several thousand pounds following behind you.

This 2025 Sierra 3500HD Denali has just 37,847 miles and pairs its 6.6L Duramax turbodiesel V8 with a 10-speed automatic and 4WD. An exhaust brake, engine block heater, heavy-duty battery, and off-road suspension add to a setup that makes sense for someone who expects their truck to work hard.

But you're still spending a lot of time in the driver's seat. Forge perforated leather, Bose® audio, a power sunroof, and power-retractable assist steps make the Denali feel a long way from a basic work truck.

And with a pre-owned heavy-duty truck, condition matters. This Sierra has been thoroughly safety-inspected by our Valley Service team before being offered for sale.

If you're comparing heavy-duty trucks for an RV, equipment trailer, or serious work, this is the kind of truck worth looking at closely: diesel capability when you need it, Denali comfort when the miles start adding up.
